messages.subject: Greetings and Seeking Shiny Expertise
parts:
Happy New Year!

I have developed an app (in collaboration) devoted to analyzing course gradebook data. The goal is to provide an easy tool that enables instructors to produce summary statistics and plots to visualize student performance. The app is currently hosted here: http://gradebook.plb.ucdavis.edu:8080/. It is built using React (www.reactjs.org) and uses a separate server running R. The plots are built using Plotly.

The programmer I have been working with is very busy and unable to continue development. There are several changes I would like to make, but I am curious to know the feasibility of re-building it as a Shiny app. I would be grateful for opinions from Shiny enthusiasts.

I am also open to hiring a GSR or similar position to bring this project to fruition. If you have experience working in React or think you could develop this into a Shiny app, please contact me (jmle...@ucdavis.edu).

Thank you!
